events.title: THE GOLDEN HOURS
events.description: No screens, all presence. Screen devices left at the door. events.title: Convergent Bodies: First Leap
events.description: Image Credit: Bianca Tainsh (microscopy image with Sandra Tuszynska) Convergent Bodies is a visceral self-identification with other interspecies bodies and the emergence of a speculative posthuman future where technology is applied as ecological steward and interlocutor for entanglement with the more-than-human. In an 11-week OCCUPY residency, artist Bianca Tainsh has been visualising this concept through experimental juxtapositions of a vast exploratory archive of organic artefacts and digital documentation, and an accumulating body of aesthetic and conceptual research exploring microscopic and subterranean realms and the relational and metaphysical entanglement of all species. Unlike Haeckel's Art Forms in Nature , Tainsh's archive seeks the wild asymmetries of decay, sexual manifestation, and symbiosis. Convergent Bodies: First Leap is the initial manifestation of a new body of work that will take its cues from Tainsh's residency experiments. #block-f1e6d2ae56c80dd9e160 { } #block-f1e6d2ae56c80dd9e160 .sqs-html-content { } #block-f1e6d2ae56c80dd9e160 { mix-blend-mode: var(--tweak-text-block-blend ); events.title: Portrait Painting Workshop - Dave fENOGLIO
events.description: #block-yui_3_17_2_1_1787275646529_9720 { --opacity: 100%; --translate-x: 0px; --translate-y: 0px; --rotation: 0deg; --scale-x: 100%; --scale-y: 100%; --skew-x: 0deg; --skew-y: 0deg; --origin-x: 50%; --origin-y: 50%; --block-transform: none; opacity: var(--opacity, 1); transform: var(--block-transform); transform-origin: var(--origin-x) var(--origin-y); } Join multiple Archibald Portrait Prize finalist David Fenoglio for a two-day portrait painting workshop. The workshop will focus on natural and realistic representation of the live model in oils. Limited to 8 places. 9am - 3:30pm both days.  An alla prima approach will be demonstrated, including blocking in shapes, proportion, anatomy, design, value/colour relationships, colour mixing and paint handling. Foundational principles will be discussed while demonstrating a variety of technical approaches. Day one will focus on anatomy and proportion with students creating a block-in drawing and one short alla prima painting from the live model.  Day two will focus on modelling form, colour mixing and paint application with students creating one longer alla prima painting from a live model. #block-cc2ba05bcd2c9bbadd9e { } #block-cc2ba05bcd2c9bbadd9e .sqs-html-content { } #block-cc2ba05bcd2c9bbadd9e { mix-blend-mode: var(--tweak-text-block-blend ); border-radius: var(--tweak-text-block-radius); } @media screen and (max-width: 767px) { #block-cc2ba05bcd2c9bbadd9e { } } @media screen and (max-width: 767px) { #block-cc2ba05bcd2c9bbadd9e .sqs-html-content { } } @media screen and (max-width: 767px) { } #block-yui_3_17_2_1_1787275646529_11920 { --opacity: 100%; --translate-x: 0px; --translate-y: 0px; --rotation: 0deg; --scale-x: 100%; --scale-y: 100%; --skew-x: 0deg; --skew-y: 0deg; --origin-x: 50%; --origin-y: 50%; --block-transform: none; opacity: var(--opacity, 1); transform: var(--block-transform); transform-origin: var(--origin-x) var(--origin-y); } LEARN MORE #block-yui_3_17_2_1_1787275646529_12294 { --sqs-block-content-flex: 0; } #block-yui_3_17_2_1_1787275646529_12294 { --opacity: 100%; --translate-x: 0px; --translate-y: 0px; --rotation: 0deg; --scale-x: 100%; --scale-y: 100%; --skew-x: 0deg; --skew-y: 0deg; --origin-x: 50%; --origin-y: 50%; --block-transform: none; opacity: var(--opacity, 1); transform: var(--block-transform); transform-origin: var(--origin-x) var(--origin-y); }
